messages:
anne (Product): Heads up — big customer asks this week around contract-level commitments for audit exports + BYOK. They want three things: guaranteed export latency (within 2h), per-tenant TTL overrides for legal hold, and a formal KMS escrow option. Need to align launch criteria and what we can promise per tier.

sam (Eng): Can we unpack the export latency ask — is that streaming vs batch? 2h sounds like a batch SLA.

emily (Customer Success): Customer says: they need exports available in a searchable format within 2 hours of request, and legal hold means stop deletion + immediate snapshot. They want an SLA in the contract.

mira (Security): BYOK + escrow raises compliance questions. Escrow only if legal/contract covers access conditions. Also need to define key custody timeline and who signs escrow access.

kevin (Sales): From deal perspective we can tier this: Hosted/Standard — 24h export; Dedicated — 4h; Enterprise — 2h + BYOK escrow. Customer wants Enterprise terms but will only sign if we promise retention overrides for legal hold.

julia (Legal): We can offer escrow but need explicit legal triggers for key release (court order / customer consent). Also need indemnity language. Drafting a standard appendix is doable but will take time.

sam (Eng): Technical constraints: export pipeline currently runs nightly job + on-demand export that can be slow under load. To hit 2h we need: on-demand export priority queue, archive hot path, and an indexer to make exported logs searchable. Estimates: ~3 sprints across infra + one sprint for API + storage config.

anne (Product): Good — propose launch criteria: (1) Export API that returns searchable bundle within 2h under 95th percentile for Enterprise tests, (2) Tenant-level retention toggle + legal-hold flag preserving snapshots, (3) BYOK with documented escrow workflow + legal appendix. Anything missing?

mira (Security): Also add audit trail for any escrow access (who, when, justification) and retention of those audit entries for 7 years.

kevin (Sales): Pricing note: escrow and 2h SLA should be an enterprise add-on. We need clear cost impact for RD. Customers will expect credits if SLA violated.

emily (Customer Success): Operational ask: runbook + playbook for executing a legal hold request end-to-end. Ops needs to know steps, RTOs, and who to page.

ops-bot: Reminder: last time we ran the on-demand export test it timed out at 3h under 80% load. See run: https://ci.internal/export-tests/2026-02-14

sam (Eng): Ok — action items: 1) infra spike to prototype hot-path export (owner: sam) due in 2w, 2) retention API spec (owner: anne) due next week, 3) escrow appendix draft (owner: julia) due EOW, 4) ops runbook draft (owner: emily) due in 10 days.

anne (Product): Prioritization question: do we treat this as gated enterprise feature (requires Dedicated/Private) or try to support hosted Enterprise with limits? Thoughts?

mira (Security): Hosted is riskier for BYOK/escrow because keys don't sit in customer VPC. If we support hosted, escrow model must include a customer-managed KMS (BYOK) in a cloud region we approve.

kevin (Sales): Most target customers prefer Dedicated or VPC-backed hosted with BYOK. Recommend gating full 2h + escrow to Dedicated/Private for now, offer 4h for hosted Enterprise as an interim.

anne (Product): Sounds like consensus. I'll update the roadmap ticket: gate full commitments to Dedicated/Private, interim hosted SLA option, owners and dates as Sam listed, and require security + legal signoff before customer-facing commitments.

julia (Legal): I'll attach a draft escrow appendix to the ticket and highlight the access triggers we need.

emily (Customer Success): I'll start drafting the ops playbook template and gather typical customer legal-hold workflows to include.

sam (Eng): I'll post results of the infra spike in this thread when ready. If we can shave the prototype to <1.5h median we can negotiate tougher terms.

anne (Product): Thanks all — cc @kevin to start communicating interim commitments to the customer. We'll sync next Wed for a status update. :thumbsup:
